question: In which of the following states of India is the festival Baisakhi celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Baisakhi is primarily celebrated in the Punjab region of India. It holds significant religious, cultural, and historical importance for the Sikh community.
 
• Guru Gobind Singh Ji, the tenth Sikh Guru, founded the Khalsa Panth on this day in 1699.
 
• This marked a significant turning point in Sikh history, emphasizing the principles of equality, courage, and self-sacrifice.
 
• Baisakhi is a time for spiritual renewal and devotion. Sikhs visit Gurudwaras, participate in prayers, and seek blessings.
 
• Baisakhi is a harvest festival, celebrating the bountiful harvest season.
 
• Farmers express gratitude for a good crop and pray for prosperity in the coming year.
 
• Baisakhi also marks the Punjabi New Year, symbolizing new beginnings and fresh opportunities
